newsitem.title: JAPAN: Strong tremor rocks Tokyo, man injured.
newsitem.headline: Strong tremor rocks Tokyo, man injured.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.5 on the open-ended Richter scale rocked Tokyo and nearby areas on Saturday morning, halting rail transport for up to two hours, officals said.
Japan's Meteorological Agency said the epicentre of the earthquake was 100 km (60 miles) north of Tokyo.
There were no serious injuries, although a 36-year-old man was hurt by falling objects and a 66-year-old man was trapped in a railway station elevator for about 40 minutes.
Railway officials said high-speed intercity bullet trains travelling through the area were halted for up to two hours and an expressway in the region was closed as a precaution.
